about_short_description.short_description: HumanLayer is a Software Development firm offering safe access for AI to keep Human in loop for the workflow.

product.name: HumanLayer API and SDK
product.description: An API and SDK that enable AI agent builders to create AI agents with human-like interactions and human-in-the-loop workflows across multiple communication channels.

product.name: Human Approval Workflows
product.description: A system to require and manage human approvals for AI agent function calls, including multi-team coordination, escalations, and timeouts.

product.name: OmniChannel Contact Channels
product.description: Integration of multiple communication channels such as Slack, Email, Discord, and others to contact humans for approvals, feedback, or advice within AI workflows.

product.name: Human as Tool
product.description: A feature that allows AI agents to treat humans as tools for obtaining answers, advice, or feedback during task execution.

product.name: Learning and Auto Approvals
product.description: A system that automates approval or denial of AI agent requests based on thresholds set from past human interactions.

product.name: Exporting Datasets for Training and Evaluations
product.description: A capability to export human feedback collected during AI agent interactions into labeled datasets for model fine-tuning or evaluation.
